description: The final capture summary must report zero decode errors.
rationale: Decode errors undermine packet contents before any downstream transport, signal, or ML metric can trust samples.

description: The final capture summary must report zero queue drops.
rationale: Queue drops prove the capture path lost packets before analysis.

description: The capture must include muse.summary cadence events.
rationale: Summary events provide producer/capture counters needed to validate drops, decode errors, queue pressure, and throughput.

description: The artifact must contain exactly one capture_start and one capture_stop event.
rationale: Capture lifecycle bounds are required for duration coverage and reproducibility.

description: Aggregate event/sample/summary timestamp regressions must be zero.
rationale: Negative host-time deltas corrupt ordering, segmentation, and timing diagnostics.

description: Per-stream sequence gaps should be zero for streams with sequence counters.
rationale: Sequence gaps indicate packet loss or missed notifications on counter-bearing streams. Telemetry duplicate sequence behavior is handled separately.

description: Per-stream out-of-order sequence counts should be zero for streams with sequence counters.
rationale: Out-of-order counters corrupt time-series ordering and later window construction.

description: Classic Muse EEG packet/event rate should stay near the observed ~21.3 Hz per EEG channel.
rationale: Each classic Muse EEG notification carries a chunk of samples. This threshold gates transport cadence, not EEG signal quality.

description: ACC/GYRO event rates should remain near the observed ~17.8 Hz per stream when those streams are enabled.
rationale: IMU cadence supports motion context; deviations should be reviewed but do not alone fail EEG transport.

description: Aggregate inter-sample-event p99 should remain below 100 ms for the current classic Muse capture path.
rationale: This catches host/BLE stalls while tolerating normal stream interleaving and scheduling jitter. It is provisional and should be tightened with more captures.

description: Summary cadence p95 should be near 1 Hz when summary events are enabled.
rationale: Summary cadence drift points to event-loop stalls or capture shutdown edges; this is a monitoring warning, not a physiology gate.

description: Maximum observed queue fill should stay below 25% of configured queue capacity.
rationale: Queue pressure is an early warning before packet drops occur.

description: Sample coverage should span at least 75% of the capture lifecycle for transport baselines.
rationale: The no-contact baseline includes connection/setup and clean shutdown edges, so this is intentionally a warning threshold rather than a hard gate.
